title: Meta Hackathon build prompt and orchestration map
verification: Source inspection; fresh live execution is recorded separately
policy: Meta models only; automated checks exclude Fireworks; models never approve recovery or operational release

order.input: Snapshot-bound system prompt, read-only tool definitions, incident evidence and deterministic recovery calculations
order.output: Validated feasible option, source claims, concise narrative and read-only trace

order.input: Latest valid Baseten investigation on the same snapshot: run ID, digest, selected option and accepted source claims; independent incident and comparison tool reads
order.output: Strict final JSON envelope and exact-source checked claims

order.input: A successful current-snapshot investigation and feasible calculated option
order.output: Typed single-use acceptance sealed to operator, session, snapshot and recomputed plan digest

order.input: Accepted investigation handoff, human decision, selected option, exact evidence, scoped encrypted memory and prior board
order.output: Strictly validated pending task proposal, not tracked until human approval

order.input: Unexpired proposal bound to deciding session, snapshot and decision nonce
order.output: Tracked task board and ledgered approval
New snapshot, invalidated acceptance and blocked affected tasks; Baseten then Wonder then human acceptance then Britt re-plan repeats

limits.investigationFailure: Stops on model error, identity mismatch, invalid envelope, unsupported tool/schema, repeated tool call or deadline; explicit human retry starts a new bounded run
limits.brittFallbackBudget: Remaining portion of the shared 45000 ms budget

schemas.tool: Allowlisted names, object arguments, no unknown argument keys; read-only incident/evidence/jobs/options/capacity tools bound to server snapshot
schemas.final: Exactly action, claims, narrative, optionId; final action; nonempty narrative at most 12000 characters; at most 100 claims; feasible selected option or explicit no-feasible-options analysis
schemas.claim: Evidence ID plus exact value, unit, document ID, record ID, field and optional line ID; unknown keys rejected; all live claims must pass and at least one accepted claim is required
schemas.liveProposal: Successful bounded run, at least two read-only calls, valid final schema, accepted exact-source claims and no rejected claims
schemas.tasks: Exactly summary and tasks; task keys exactly id, title, owner, dueHours, dependsOn, evidenceIds; owner matches operator; finite due hours within accepted option window; unique IDs, valid acyclic dependencies and ordered dependency deadlines; nonempty evidence subset from selected option
schemas.taskCount: Prompt requests 3 to 6; validator supports 1 to 12
schemas.snapshotGuards: Reject stale investigation, changed decision nonce, stale proposal, changed plan hash, replayed or expired consent

authority.models: Read evidence, calculate through allowlisted tools, propose and explain
authority.human: Accept recovery with exact typed phrase, approve tasks, apply shock and move tracked tasks
authority.deterministicEngine: Own quantities, costs, capacity, feasibility and plan arithmetic
authority.memory: Encrypted session/operator-scoped retained summaries; task drafts receive only matching-scope memory

freshLiveResult: Not yet recorded in this source-inspection artifact
